BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
PASSPORTS ACT
(Chapter 146)
PASSPORTS (VISA) (EXEMPTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2026
In exercise of the power conferred by section 4 of the Passports Act, His
Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby makes the following Order-
Citation and commencement
1. This Order may be cited as the Passports (Visa) (Exemption) (Amendment)
Order, 2026 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 3rd July 2025.
Amendment of Schedule 3 to 0 1 of Chapter 146
2. Schedule 3 to the Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order, in this Order referred
to as the principal Order, is amended by inserting the following new item
immediately after "The Kingdom of Cambodia" -
"48A. The Republic of Kosovo".
Amendment of Schedule 4
3. Schedule 4 to the principal Order is amended by inserting the following new
item immediately after "The Kingdom of Cambodia"-
"45A. The Republic of Kosovo".
Made this 25th. day of Rejab, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the
15th. day of January, 2026 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan,
Brunei Darussalam.
HIS MAJESTY
THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN,
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510,
Negara Brunei Darussalam.
